note_on_provider: CONNECT_PROVIDER writes a secret server-side; nobody (client or founder UI) can read it back.
enforcement: role from project_members on the server; never from request body/query (today: body.role / roleOverride trusted)
RLS by membership on every project-owned table
approve allowed only when review status is AWAITING/IN_REVIEW and gate open

security_review.provider_connections: encrypted, project-scoped, never returned; audit log in site00_connection_events
security_review.project_costs: client sees CLIENT_VISIBLE_PRODUCTION_EXPENSE only; internal fields stripped server-side
security_review.client_identity: Supabase auth + membership; invite tokens hashed, single-use, expiring; magic link must not auto-create users on invite-only projects
security_review.project_access: membership check on every API; no client-chosen role
security_review.files: per-project bucket paths; signed download URLs; upload type/size limits; malware scanning later
security_review.messages: project-scoped; no internal agent chat in client threads
security_review.approval_history: append-only events; reversals are new events; no silent rewrite
